name: FireControl
description: Client-side helper for CubicMetre's Orbital Strike Cannons and Danda420's 360 pearl cannon. Pairs with your panel and cannon, sets a target in one command, enters the settings for you and counts down to impact.
contributors: CubicMetre (Orbital Strike Cannon and fire control maths)
Danda420 (360 Precision Ender Pearl Cannon and its calculator)
